summary: The flake is a test sequencing/readiness race, not evidence of a broken PodCertificate or mTLS implementation. The test starts its fixed 30-second poll for a success line before the server and client deployments are guaranteed healthy; the worker runtime log shows client containers still being created during the failing run. The merged fix waits for both deployments to complete before starting the mTLS log poll.
evidence_markers: client logs did not contain expected success message pattern
Got response body: Client Identity: spiffe://
leak_terms: waits for the server and client deployments to be healthy
